items.source: The first argument is the array component type. The second argument is an InlineList representing the array initializer, if an initializer was supplied in the expression.
items.translation: 第一个参数是数组组件类型。第二个参数是一个 `InlineList`，表示如果表达式中提供了初始化器，则代表该数组初始化器。

items.source:
The first argument is the type. The rest are the arguments to the
constructor.
items.translation: 第一个参数是类型。其余参数是构造函数的参数。

items.source:
Represents the invocation of a constructor: either a constructor on a regular type or construction of an array. When an array is constructed, an initializer can be specified.

Examples

  • new example.Foo()
  • new String('hello world')
  • new int[] {1,2,3,4}
  • new String[] {'abc','xyz'}
  • new int[5]
  • new int[3][4]
items.translation:
表示构造函数的调用：即常规类型的构造函数或数组的创建。当创建数组时，可以指定初始化器。

示例

  • new example.Foo()
  • new String('hello world')
  • new int[] {1,2,3,4}
  • new String[] {'abc','xyz'}
  • new int[5]
  • new int[3][4]
